questions.label: What should Browser screenshots capture by default?
questions.help: Recommended: capture the visible viewport by default because it matches what the user is annotating and reviewing; full-page can be a later explicit option.

questions.label: What should Browser annotations contain?
questions.help: Recommended: visual mark plus optional text comment and coordinates, so the prompt attachment is understandable by both user and runtime.
options: Visual mark, optional text comment, and coordinates

questions.label: Should Browser annotations persist after send?
questions.help: Recommended: persist on the sent attachment record, then clear active unsent annotations from the Browser surface after send.
options: Persist on sent attachment record; clear active surface annotations after send
Persist visually in the Browser surface after send

questions.label: What is the Browser plugin state scope?
questions.help: Recommended: per chat session, matching the accepted plugin instance and panel restore model.
